g.text: Data flow 3: a record command commits in one transaction at the data service; the retry, the
conflict, version adoption and the canary's replay take the same path (arrows: data flow in the
direction the data moves; label = Fn payload [protocol, authentication; data class])
B2 The VPC: the edge, the workspace server, the data service and the stores (trust boundary)
B1 The Internet: members' browsers (trust boundary)
B4 Data service: the only writer of records (trust boundary)
